about.title: About Us
about.heroText: DRON.BY is a store, service center, and pilot community all in one. We choose equipment we trust and help you get it in the air.
about.timeline2024Text: Launched online store and assembled the first team of pilot-consultants.
about.timeline2025Text: Opened a full-cycle workshop and a pilot school for beginners and pros.
about.timeline2026Text: Signed distribution agreements with key global brands.

home.advantagesSub: Everything that matters to our customers
home.newsletterTitle: Stay updated on new arrivals and promotions
home.newsletterSub: Subscribe to our newsletter — no spam, only important drone news
home.newsletterThanks: Thanks! {{email}} has been added to our newsletter.
home.hero1Text: Professional quadcopters, FPV drones, accessories, and spare parts. Official warranty, delivery across Belarus, and service support for pilots of any level.
home.hero2Title: FPV drones for thrill and speed
home.hero2Text: Ready-to-fly kits and components for DIY builds: frames, motors, ELRS receivers, and goggles. We'll help configure your perfect setup.
home.hero3Text: Flagship DJI Mavic 4 Pro, Air 3S, and Autel EVO II Pro V3 — for 4K/6K shooting, professional projects, and travel.
home.adv1Text: Across Belarus by courier and post — fast and safe.
home.adv1Details: We deliver orders by courier in Minsk on the day of registration, to other regions via Europost and CDEK within 1–3 days. Free delivery for orders over 300 BYN. Pickup available from our office at Prytytskogo str., 79.
home.adv2Text: Service center in Minsk and manufacturer support.
home.adv2Details: All drones and accessories are original products with an official 12-month manufacturer warranty. Warranty and post-warranty service are performed at our own service center, certified by DJI and Autel.
home.adv3Text: We'll help you choose a drone, set it up, and advise on flights.
home.adv3Details: Consultants are available via chat, phone, and email at any time. We'll help you choose the right model for your needs, set up the app, understand flight modes, and firmware updates.
home.adv4Text: Only certified DJI, Autel, Insta360, BetaFPV.
home.adv4Details: We work directly with distributors of DJI, Autel Robotics, Insta360, GoPro, BetaFPV, and PGYTECH. Every product comes with a receipt, warranty card, and certificate — guaranteeing authenticity and official updates.
home.cat1Text: Versatile models for aerial photography and travel: DJI Mini, Mavic, Air, Autel EVO.
home.cat1Details: The section features foldable DJI Mini 4 Pro and Mini 5 drones, Mavic 3 Pro and Mavic 4 Pro flagships, mid-range Air 3S, as well as Autel EVO Lite+ and EVO II Pro V3. We'll help you choose a Fly More kit and explain the differences in sensors and shooting modes.
home.cat2Text: Racing and cinematic FPV: DJI Avata 2, BetaFPV Pavo20, ready-to-fly kits for pilots.
home.cat2Details: Ready-to-fly kits for beginners (BetaFPV Cetus Pro, DJI Avata 2 Fly More) and components for DIY builds: frames, motors, ESC, FC, VTX, ELRS receivers. We'll help you choose the perfect configuration for your flying style.
home.cat3Text: Goggles, controllers, batteries, ND filters, cases — everything for comfortable flights.
home.cat3Details: DJI Goggles 3, RC 2 with screen, Motion 3 controllers, ND filter sets for Mavic and Air, PGYTECH landing pads, waterproof cases, and carrying bags. Everything to make shooting easier.
home.cat4Text: Original parts and consumables: propellers, motors, ESC, frames, and gimbals.
home.cat4Details: Original DJI propellers, motors and ESC from T-Motor and BetaFPV, frames for FPV builds, cables, gimbals, and replacement batteries. Everything in stock — we can replace a part within 1 day at our service center.
home.review1Text: Ordered DJI Mavic 3 — everything arrived in 2 days, they helped with setup over the phone. I recommend the store!
home.review2Text: Got an FPV kit for my son, the guys helped choose a setup within the budget. Thanks for the personalized approach.
home.review3Text: Great service: gimbal repair was done in 3 days, fair price, the drone works like new.
home.news1Title: How to choose a drone for beginners
home.news1Text: Understanding the key features: flight time, camera, range. What to buy with your first drone.
home.news2Text: Review of this year's DJI models: key differences of the Mavic 4 Pro, Mini 5, and the updated Osmo lineup.
